card.title: Nintendo Switch Orange Screen On Bootup Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Orange Screen On Bootup Repair

claims.statement: The Switch orange screen is a hardware fault caused by the Broadcom BCM4356XKUBG Wi-Fi IC losing BGA contact, usually from drops or pocket bending.

Try a 12 s power-off first; then reflow (preheat ~300 °C at 40 L/min, then 420–450 °C until flux bubbles, tap gently) with the board out and eMMC removed; a failed reflow can cause no power, requiring IC replacement.

procedure: Remove board and eMMC, lift the EMI shield.
Preheat, then reflow the Wi-Fi IC; or replace it.
Clean flux; test Wi-Fi speed and full system.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Reflowing can leave the console with no power; don't reflow with the board in the case.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
